_comment: Example zones file for the separation distance. K, T and C have NO default: while any of them is null the zone is reported as not_evaluated and nothing is computed with an invented value. Fill them in only from your own risk assessment. S = K * T + C is indicative, it is not a certification.
_comment_separation: Machine-wide figures, used by every zone that does not declare its own. approach_speed_mps = K (m/s), total_stop_time_s = T (s, detection reaction plus the full stopping time of the machine), intrusion_distance_m = C (m, ISO 13857). tool_deceleration_mps2 is optional.
_comment_required: true: a zone that is not evaluated makes a verdict that would be READY INHIBITED. false (default): the verdict is unchanged and the answer only reports the zone as not_evaluated.
